integrity.bibliographic_risk: Potential alternate terminology for truncated unconditional cubical cones; known isolated four-point benchmark credited.
integrity.mathematical_evidence: Analytic reduction of all quadratic forms by sign-permutation averaging, exact inner and outer radii, monotone minimax branches, and unique parameter intersection.
integrity.verification: Independent exact rational reconstruction of selected vertices, plus 63 parameter cases and 25,200 rational shape comparisons; finite checks do not replace proof.

limitations: Real spaces only; integer m at least 2; unit spokes; 0<t<=2; the collapsed t=0 metric is excluded.
The theorem gives the global optimal Hilbert distortion and a symmetric optimal quadratic shape, not the classification of every nonsymmetric optimizer.
An unindexed equivalent statement remains possible; self-review is not independent validation.
title: Sharp Hilbert-distortion crossover for weighted book metrics
